evidence: Touches `src/net_processing.cpp` and `src/net_permissions.{h,cpp}`, adding a `bip152hb` permission flag for compact block relay.
rationale: Allows node operators to explicitly designate high-bandwidth BIP152 compact block peers outside the dynamic three-peer limit. As noted in the description, this enables multi-datacenter setups or low-latency peering links to receive compact blocks immediately without waiting for dynamic selection or losing state on disconnects.
